title: State influence operations - China (United Front / Spamouflage) + Russia (Doppelganger) + proxies, as a competing explanatory frame
source: Public record + attributed research: China's United Front Work Department (party-state overseas influence coordination) + the 'Spamouflage'/Dragonbridge inauthentic-network (attributed by Google/Mandiant, Meta, Graphika, US DOJ 2024 domain seizures); Russia's 'Doppelganger' campaign (cloned Western news domains + fake articles; EU DisinfoLab 2022, Meta takedowns, US Treasury/DOJ 2024 sanctions + indictments) run via Russian intel-linked firms (Social Design Agency etc.). Overlay on the existing China / Russia / Spamouflage / Russian_Intel / Russia_state threads (structural; no financial-core edges). HONESTY: the NAMED, ATTRIBUTED operations = fact (with attributor cited); their MEASURED impact on Western opinion is contested + generally assessed as modest; any 'subtle / unknown / potential' operation is STRICTLY LABELED SPECULATION per the reject-apophenia rule - a hypothesis-generator, never an assertion. The point of the block: some 'pressure / deplatforming / narrative' activity that the EA/AI-network map does not explain may be STATE INFLUENCE OPS instead - a distinct, parallel frame, NOT proof of one cabal.

edges.notes: The United Front Work Department is the CCP organ coordinating overseas influence, diaspora mobilization, and elite cultivation - an openly acknowledged party structure (fact of existence + remit; specific operational attributions vary in confidence).
United Front work is the strategic/coordination layer of Chinese state influence (fact).

'Spamouflage'/Dragonbridge is the large inauthentic pro-PRC social-media network attributed by Google/Mandiant, Meta, and Graphika; DOJ seized related domains in 2024. High-volume but generally assessed as LOW-engagement/impact (fact of the network + attribution; impact contested = modest).

Both sit within the PRC influence apparatus; direct command linkage between UFWD and Spamouflage specifically is NOT firmly established in open sources - treat the tie as apparatus-level, not a proven chain of command (fact of co-membership in the apparatus; specific control link = speculation, labeled).

'Doppelganger' clones Western news domains (Guardian, Bild, Le Monde, etc.) to push fake articles; attributed to Russia by EU DisinfoLab (2022), Meta, and via US Treasury/DOJ 2024 sanctions + indictments naming Russian firms (Social Design Agency, Structura). Fact of the operation + attribution; measured Western-opinion impact contested.

Doppelganger is run through Russian-intel-linked contractors under Presidential-administration direction per US/EU attributions (fact of the attribution; exact tasking chain partly classified/contested).
Doppelganger is the Russian pillar of the state-influence frame (fact).

COMPETING-EXPLANATION NOTE: state influence ops are one reason Western regimes cite for content rules (DSA 'foreign interference'; the UK/AU 'online harms' framing) - AND a possible alternative explanation for some narrative/deplatforming activity the EA/AI map doesn't cover. The two interact: real ops give real cover for broad speech powers (interpretation, labeled). No claim that any specific Western takedown WAS an op.

Parallel frame: influence ops, financial chokepoints, activist campaigns, and state regulation are DISTINCT overlapping drivers of the online-narrative environment - held as competing hypotheses, not one unified actor (interpretation, labeled).

SPECULATION, STRICTLY LABELED: 'subtle / unknown / potential' influence operations (e.g. via infrastructure, funding, or proxy media) are a HYPOTHESIS-GENERATOR for gaps the documented networks leave - never an assertion. This edge marks the open question, tied to the existing foreign-influence-claim node; it is not evidence of any specific covert operation (speculation).
